parts.note_add: Sits inside the case on the manual shaft; its pin drives the manual valve in the control valve body and its detent notches give the selector positions (N is the third detent from the rear, per the 1980 manual).

Runs from the manual plate back into the extension housing, where its rear end rides between the two spring-loaded steel balls of the actuator support; it is unhooked by removing a snap ring at the parking lever.
Bolted inside the extension housing; its two steel balls press the parking rod against the pawl in P.
Mounted in the extension housing on its pawl shaft; the factory inspection is a visual check for wear or damage, with no dimension given.

The manual-linkage adjustment is made with the selector in N: the T-joint nuts on the rod are set so the joint enters the hole of the lever on the case freely; check whether FA03-46-571 is the rod that carries that T-joint.

specs.item: Selector N position on the case lever: detent counted from the rear of the transmission
specs.note: 1980 3N71B manual; no 1982 source gives it; check on the car

specs.item: Assembly: the pin on the manual plate engages the manual valve groove when the control valve body is fitted
specs.note: 1980 manual; the 1985 L4N71B manual shows the same manual plate, nut, parking rod and manual shaft layout (S-002 7B-59)

specs.item: Removal: loosen the manual plate attaching nut, then remove manual shaft and manual plate (after the parking rod)
specs.note: no torque for the manual plate nut is given in the 1980 or 1985 manuals or the 1982 Technical Data

specs.item: Fitting: rear end of the parking rod sits between the two steel balls in the actuator supporter when the extension housing is installed
specs.note: 1980 manual; two steel balls 9961-12-750 on the 1981-82 catalogue figure 1950A-1 agree

specs.item: Removal: remove the snap ring from the parking lever, disconnect the lever, then remove the parking rod

specs.page: Section 7B, 7B-59 extension housing figure 47U07B-119 (item 12, bolts x2)
specs.note: 1985 L4N71B manual; no 1982 source gives this torque

specs.item: Inspection: check the parking steel balls for wear or damage
Inspection: check the parking pawl for wear or damage
specs.note: pawl, springs, retaining plate and balls come out of the extension housing after the lock plate and speedometer driven gear; no wear dimension given

specs.item: Manual linkage adjustment: selector in N, T-joint nuts loosened and set so the T-joint freely enters the hole of the selector lever operating arm, then tightened
specs.note: 1980 manual; engine idle must be set first; check which rod carries the T-joint on the car
